title: Backing Up Important Files
paragraphs: After his laptop suddenly stops working one morning, Wahyu panics briefly, realizing that months of important work documents might be permanently lost with no other copy saved anywhere else.

A technician later manages to recover most of his files, but the stressful hours of uncertainty convince Wahyu to finally set up automatic cloud backup, something he had been postponing for over a year.
Setting it up takes only about fifteen minutes, far less effort than he had originally assumed, and now his files save automatically every time he makes a change to any important document.
A few months later, when his laptop is stolen from his car, Wahyu feels far calmer than expected, since he knows every important file is already safely stored elsewhere online.
